author: GameTrailers
description:
The Posthumous Investigation is available now on Steam. Watch the launch trailer for The Posthumous Investigation, a time-loop murder mystery game from developer Mother Gaia Studio. 

In The Posthumous Investigation, play as a private investigator who’s been hired by a rather unusual client: an influential entrepreneur who’s already dead. The task? You only have a single day to solve the mystery of his murder. Adventure through a hand-drawn, noir-drenched 1937 Rio de Janeiro and learn about the lives of a cast of unique characters. Question their actions, challenge their motives, and manipulate their routines to uncover as much information as you can. When the day resets, take your knowledge with you through the time loop to stay one step ahead of the killer. In The Posthumous Investigation, death is the client, and time is your only weapon.
title: The Posthumous Investigation - Official Launch Trailer

author: GameTrailers
description: Homura: The Crimson Warriors is available now on Nintendo Switch. Watch the Homura: The Crimson Warriors gameplay trailer for this visual novel. Learn about the ninja way of life under the Sanada Ten Braves as protagonist Mutsumi Mochizuki in this gameplay trailer. Meet the characters and see more of Homura: The Crimson Warriors.
title: Homura: The Crimson Warriors - Official Gameplay Trailer

description: You wake up. You’re a potato. Start small. Get bigger. Confuse everyone. Good luck! Watch the Potato Simulator trailer for this upcoming game. Potato Simulator will be available on PC in 2026.
title: Potato Simulator - Official Trailer

author: GameTrailers
description:
Watch the Magic: The Gathering: Secrets of Strixhaven cinematic trailer. Follow Tam, Abigale, Kirol, Sanar, and Lluwen as they race against the clock and try to make the grade. Magic: The Gathering Secrets of Strixhaven will be available everywhere from April 24, 2026.

Return to Strixhaven, Magic’s beloved mage school, and uncover years of mysteries as you explore its hallowed halls and beyond. The five colleges are back, each with their own unique look, feel, and magic focus. As you increase your skills, make academic discoveries, and work to prove your college is the best, beware – second-year knowledge comes with a side of increased danger. Get ready to face your greatest test yet!
title: Magic: The Gathering: Secrets of Strixhaven - Official Cinematic Trailer

author: GameTrailers
description: Take a look at Tenebris: Terra Incognita, a turn-based tactical RPG in which you will explore a harsh planet teeming with terrifying monsters. Experiment with talent builds for 23 heroes. Combine abilities with equipment and other characters. Assemble a squad and learn the secrets of the planet Tenebris! Tenebris: Terra Incognita is out now on Steam Early Access.
title: Tenebris: Terra Incognita - Official Trailer

author: GameTrailers
description: Don't miss the Release Date Announcement Trailer for Masters of the Universe: Legends Unite, a cooperative deck-building game developed by Bandit Island Games. Players will team up with heroes and villains alike to engage in card-based battles to succeed in Eternia's Trials. Collect powerful cards, unleash devastating abilities, and claim victory at all costs. Masters of the Universe: Legends Unite is launching on June 5 for Amazon Luna.
title: Masters of the Universe: Legends Unite - Official Release Date Announcement Trailer

author: GameTrailers
description: Take a look at the PS5 Launch Trailer for South of Midnight, a narrative-driven action-adventure game developed by Compulsion Games. Players will head into the Deep South full of modern folktales, mysterious creatures, and an ancient power full of obstacles to overcome along the way. South of Midnight is available now for PlayStation 5 (PS5), alongside Xbox Series X|S, Nintendo Switch 2, and PC (Steam).
title: South of Midnight - Official PS5 Launch Trailer

author: GameTrailers
description: Don't miss the Launch Trailer for Super Meat Boy 3D, a precision 3D platformer developed by Sluggerfly and Team Meat. Players will take on white-knuckled, blood-pumping platforming challenges in this new Super Meat Boy adventure from an all-new perspective. Overcome grueling obstacles, difficult boss fights, and the same old mayhem from previous titles in the franchise. Super Meat Boy 3D is available now for PlayStation 5 (PS5), Xbox Series X|S, Nintendo Switch 2, and PC (Steam, GoG, and Epic Games Store).
title: Super Meat Boy 3D - Official Launch Trailer

title: Extinction Day - Official Release Date Trailer

author: GameTrailers
description: Check out the launch trailer for The Division Resurgence, a mobile free-to-play third-person shooter RPG set in a shared MMO open-world. The Division Resurgence takes place in a contemporary post-crisis New York City, after a virus outbreak has created chaos and the collapse of the American government. You embody an agent of the « Strategic Homeland Division » and your mission is to restore order, combat hostile factions, protect civilians and help them build a better future. The Division Resurgence is available now for free on IOS and Android.
title: The Division Resurgence - Official Launch Trailer

author: GameTrailers
description:
Get another look at Subliminal in this trailer for the psychological horror game inspired by the urban legend of The Backrooms. Subliminal: Chapter 1 is available now on Steam.

In Subliminal, memory cannot be trusted. You awaken in a fragmented, dreamlike world shaped by subconscious fears and half-forgotten experiences. Familiar places – childhood rooms, fluorescent hallways, indoor waterparks – twist and stretch into something deeply unsettling. The world shifts as you bend light to piece together your lost memories.

Light is not just illumination, it is survival.
title: Subliminal - Official Release Trailer

description: Nether night descends. Two hearts entwined. Watch the latest trailer for Love and Deepspace to see what to expect with Caleb's new event, Ghosts' Final March.
